# Piping Flange

> Industrial pipe flange reference covering the full pressure spectrum, from Class 125LW lightweight (86 PSI) through API 6BX wellhead (20,000 PSI). Carbon, stainless, alloy, and exotic materials.

## Contact

- Phone: (281) 484-8325
- Email: sales@texasflange.com

## Site Structure

- /standards: ASME B16.5 and B16.47, AWWA C207, ANSI B16.1, DIN EN 1092-1, API 6A and 6BX
- /materials: Carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, exotic alloys
- /resources: Flange dimensions, CAD drawings, domestic vs import guidance, technical specs
- /tools: Bolt torque calculator, flange dimension lookup
- /blog: Long-form technical articles on flange selection, API vs ASME standards, bolt torque practice

## Coverage

- Sizes from 1/2 inch through 144 inch nominal pipe size
- Pressure classes from Class 125LW (AWWA C207) through Class 2500 (ASME B16.5) through 20K (API 6BX)
- Material grades: A105, A350 LF2/LF3, A516-70, A694 F42 through F70, F304/304L, F316/316L, F321, F11, F22, F91, plus Hastelloy, Inconel, Monel, duplex, and super duplex
- Domestic and imported material, and the documentation rules for each
- Mill test report traceability (EN 10204 3.1 and 3.2)
- Non-standard work: non-standard bores, overbore, special facings, RTJ grooves, weld overlay

## Standards Reference

- ASME B16.5: Pipe Flanges and Flanged Fittings, NPS 1/2 through 24
- ASME B16.47: Large Diameter Steel Flanges, NPS 26 through 60, Series A and Series B
- AWWA C207: Steel Pipe Flanges for Waterworks Service, Classes B/D/E/F
- ANSI B16.1: Cast Iron Pipe Flanges and Flanged Fittings, Class 25/125/250
- DIN EN 1092-1: Circular Flanges for Pipes, PN 6 through PN 400
- API 6A: Wellhead and Christmas Tree Equipment, 2K through 20K
- API 6BX: High-pressure flange dimensions for API 6A service
- MSS SP-44: Steel Pipeline Flanges, high yield F42 through F70
- NACE MR0175: Material restrictions for H2S sour service
